caption: What if you grew 1 cm every second? Sounds tiny, but it adds up fast. After one minute you're 60 cm taller and every door is a limbo. After one hour: 36 metres, taller than a 10-storey building. After two hours you're eye to eye with Qutub Minar (72.5 m). One day: 864 metres, past Burj Khalifa's 828 m. Ten days: about 8.6 km, with your head near Everest's summit, where the air pressure is only about a third of sea level. One year: about 315 km, almost up to the space station's 400 km orbit. To touch the Moon, 384,400 km away, you'd need to keep growing for about 1,200 years. Plot twist: you'd never make it. As Galileo worked out in 1638, double your height and you get 8x heavier, but your bones get only 4x stronger. That's why the tallest human ever measured was 2.72 m, and why the biggest animal ever, the blue whale, lives in water that carries its weight. How tall would YOU stop? 👇
